title: Samosa deployment diagram
description: How Samosa runs: one Cloudflare Worker with static assets and a D1 database. The browser runs the whole game; the Worker only issues seeds, replays submissions and serves the files.

nodes.name: Player's browser
nodes.description: Runs the whole game; one player per device.

nodes.name: Cloudflare edge
nodes.description: Runs the Worker on icelander.net/games/retro/samosa* and icelander.net/retro-games/samosa*, ahead of the games hub's custom domain.

nodes.name: samosa Worker
nodes.description: worker/index.ts: the game's page behind the sign-in, the high-score API and the scores page; every other path is a static asset from ./dist. Every path under the old address, /retro-games/samosa, gets a 308 redirect to the same path under icelander.net/games/retro/samosa.

nodes.name: Games hub
nodes.description: The games hub at icelander.net/games (the recreations repository's Worker): the sign-in pages on this host (/auth/…), /games/me and the play-time script /games/play.js. Samosa has no online play, so it never uses the hub's lobby or relay.
nodes.condition: The sign-in pages when a player is signed out; /games/play.js on every page load; /games/me for the default name in the name entry

nodes.name: icelander.net login service
nodes.description: accounts.icelander.net, in the icelander.net repository (accounts/): who holds the host's site_session cookie and their games: roles, asked on every request. The Worker reaches it only through a service binding.

artifacts.name: game.js
artifacts.description: esbuild bundle of src/main.ts, minified; served as a static asset and run in the browser.

artifacts.name: index.html and styles
artifacts.description: The page, its CSS and _headers (a strict Content-Security-Policy), copied into dist/.

artifacts.name: Worker script
artifacts.description: The fetch handler, bundled by wrangler with the engine it replays.

relationships.description: Routes icelander.net/games/retro/samosa* and icelander.net/retro-games/samosa* to the Worker.
HTTPS: the page, its assets and the API under api/.
HTTPS: GET /games/play.js; GET /games/me for the default name; /auth/… to sign in.
Service binding ACCOUNTS (entrypoint Internal): the game's page and its API need a signed-in player.
